seats.notes: WG fliers and early creatures, with Spectral Rider, Voiceless Spirit, Angel, Gallows Warden, and Abbey Griffin as evasion, plus Bonds of Faith and Spidery Grasp as answers. The white-heavy pips get 10 Plains and 7 Forests, and Avacyn's Pilgrim helps make white.

Blue-red tempo-midrange: removal (Brimstone Volley, Harvest Pyre, Claustrophobia, Sensory Deprivation, Into the Maw), solid creatures, and card advantage. Cut the second Ancient Grudge, Dissipate, Frightful Delusion, Traitorous Blood, Vampiric Fury, and the equipment for a 23-spell, 17-land build.

Going WU fliers with cheap removal, as the guide's lessons favour: Stitched Drake, Voiceless Spirit, Moon Heron, Gallows Warden and Lantern Spirit as evasion, with Claustrophobia, Sensory Deprivation and Rebuke as removal. BG, BR and the ground-heavy black cards are cut.

Two-colour White-Red aggro: 17 creatures, Rebuke, Smite the Monstrous, Into the Maw of Hell, two Moment of Heroism, and Butcher's Cleaver. Cut the blue, green, and weaker red/white tricks and equipment, and run 17 lands (9 Plains, 8 Mountain) since white is deeper.

…Dead Weight, Tribute to Hunger, Prey Upon) and three Vampire Interlopers plus Screeching Bat and Orchard Spirit for evasion, backed by Somberwald Spider for fliers. Cut Travel Preparations to hold 23 spells; 17 lands with Woodland Cemetery and a 9 Swamp / 7 Forest split for the heavier black pips.

Red-green creature deck with Garruk and three Geistflame as the removal and power core, cutting the weaker curses, Desperate Ravings and Splinterfright. Seventeen basics, nine Forest and eight Mountain, weighted slightly to green for the GG and GGG costs.

…Rebuke, Grasp of Phantoms, Hysterical Blindness x2 and two Feeling of Dread backed by Chapel-style fliers (Battleground Geist, Geistcatcher's Rig). Blue is the main colour, so 10 Islands and 6 Plains plus Moorland Haunt make 17 lands, with cheap cards and ground filler kept to a minimum.

U/B creature deck with removal (Victim of Night, Tribute to Hunger, Corpse Lunge x2) and Moan for card advantage. Cut the weak blue spells, Disciple, and the aura/curse filler; 9 Swamp and 8 Island match the colour weight.
